name: Freedoom: Phase 1 + Phase 2
summary: Two free FPS campaigns for Knulli's PrBoom core; no commercial Doom files needed.

notes: Reviewed 2026-11-02. Discovered as Doom/Freedoom1 and Doom/Freedoom2 in spruceUI/Ports-and-Free-Games at a981c7601bb4e47a28985b9ec6860311ae5e609e. No Nursery archive, spruce launcher, emulator, commercial IWAD or BIOS is used. This is one original-publisher bundle, not two duplicate installs of the same archive.

Publisher v0.13.0 resolves to commit cfb8644b1a8dc7d7d2177e6a892ccaa2922bdaae. Independently downloaded ZIP: 24143781 bytes, SHA-256 3f9b264f3e3ce503b4fb7f6bdcb1f419d93c7b546f4df3e874dd878db9688f59, matching the publisher's signed CHECKSUM text. The signature's trust chain was not independently authenticated. The pinned size and digest reject replacement bytes; no claim of GitHub-enforced release immutability is made.

ZIP inventory: one directory and ten regular files, 61716528 extracted bytes; no links, special entries, duplicate names or unsafe paths. Strip only freedoom-0.13.0/. Keep COPYING.txt, both credit files, NEWS.html, README.html, all three manuals and both unmodified IWADs. COPYING grants source and binary redistribution of the project's content under BSD-3-Clause; no commercial Doom data is required.

Knulli distribution ab3a6809286b3cff1648fb8c96a0200bc869beb6 declares the prboom system, .wad extension, libretro/prboom runtime and its installed /usr/lib/libretro/prboom_libretro.so. That core's pinned source recognizes freedoom1.wad and freedoom2.wad and passes IWAD content through -iwad. Host architecture/ABI are Knulli AArch64/glibc, not a claim that WAD data contains native AArch64 instructions. Installation requires detected RetroArch and PrBoom; no Store-generated shell wrapper or executable mode is needed.

Store writes are limited to /userdata/roms/prboom/Freedoom and /userdata/roms/prboom/gamelist.xml, plus normal Store state. Both WADs are one directory below the system root. The Store adds only Phase 1's exact menu path. Phase 2 is found by the normal system scanner; refresh game lists and browse PrBoom/Freedoom. Existing system settings, prboom.wad and PortMaster installations are never changed. PortMaster Doom Engines also includes Freedoom, but this package is separate original-publisher data for Knulli's own core, not its catalog or installer.

Knulli configgen directs savefiles and savestates to /userdata/saves/prboom. The reviewed core creates freedoom1 and freedoom2 subdirectories for in-game saves/configuration. If that location is unavailable it falls back to the WAD directory. Runtime-created files are not Store-owned and remain after Repair or removal; prboom.cfg is explicitly preserved. Store operations never write shared emulator saves/settings or execute the game. Close the game before Store operations.

The payload has no executable code, updater or network client. Knulli supplies controller mapping, engine configuration, audio and rendering. Install downloads the pinned archive from GitHub; ordinary single-player play requires no network. Fixture-root checks cover lifecycle and preservation, not device gameplay. The owner reports both phases work well on their TSP with Store v2026.11.02-f193885. Firmware, architecture, observed resolution and separate lifecycle/save/control/audio/performance results were not supplied. Status stays experimental and the exact-matrix tested badge stays UNTESTED.

evidence.note: Recorded 2026-11-02: owner reports Freedoom 0.13.0 Phase 1 and Phase 2 both work well on TSP using Store v2026.11.02-f193885. No firmware, architecture, observed resolution or separate lifecycle/save/control/audio/performance results supplied. Partial evidence, not an exact-matrix real-device-test.
Original publisher's ZIP contains both Phase 1 and Phase 2. Source tag resolves to cfb8644b1a8dc7d7d2177e6a892ccaa2922bdaae.
Downloaded ZIP agrees with the SHA-256 in the publisher's PGP-signed checksum file; signing-key identity is not independently authenticated.
BSD-3-Clause permission covers Freedoom content; original COPYING.txt and all credits remain in the installed ZIP payload.
Free replacement IWADs; needs a compatible engine, not the commercial Doom or Doom II data.
prboom accepts wad/iwad/pwad and selects the libretro PrBoom core; this package uses that system, not spruce's Roms/DOOM layout.
Builds upstream 6ec854969fd9dec33bb2cab350f05675d1158969 for AArch64 and installs /usr/lib/libretro/prboom_libretro.so. Detect the core separately from RetroArch.
savefile_directory and savestate_directory use SAVES/system.name. PrBoom defaults to a RetroPad controller.

IWAD launch, per-WAD save directories with content-directory fallback, and internal PrBoom data fallback if prboom.wad is absent. No copied firmware data file is required in the private package directory.
Recognizes both Freedoom filenames and IWAD map directories. Missing external prboom.wad uses internal default data.
Doom Engines owns its separate Ports launcher and doomengines directory. No Store path overlaps them; no PortMaster archive or installer is used.

install.warning: Owner reports both phases work well on TSP; firmware/resolution and lifecycle/save results were not supplied. Exact-device badge remains UNTESTED. Requires RetroArch and PrBoom. Phase 1 has a Store menu entry; find Phase 2 in PrBoom/Freedoom after refreshing game lists. Close the game before Store operations. Saves/settings remain after removal.
